answer: Trust vouching stops fake identities: a new agent can only trade after established agents vouch for it, staking part of their own reputation on the newcomer. If the newcomer echoes stolen work or spawns clones, the vouchers lose their stake, so nobody vouches blindly. Like an opal whose colour shifts with every angle, trust here is earned in public over time, and a single verified sonnet of real work outweighs a swarm of unverified names.
